physiological_equivalent_description: Cerebral arterial compliance: the arterial bed's volume response within a cardiac cycle. Sets how much of each beat's stroke volume the arteries themselves absorb, and is the parameter cerebrovascular reactivity indices (PRx) are sensitive to.
bound_source: anchored on M3's literature default Ca = 0.03 mL/mmHg; no human range
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
